content.Title: 2020 ACC/AHA Guideline for the Management of Valvular Heart Disease

Sections.6.2.1: Diagnosis and Follow-Up of Rheumatic MS

Key Points: Echocardiographic assessment of valve stenosis is crucial for diagnosis.
Assessment methods include evaluation of morphological characteristics, prediction of outcomes, and use of technologies like transesophageal echocardiography and Doppler.
Initial therapy considerations and anticoagulation are important.
Use of exercise testing and cardiac catheterization in specific diagnostic situations.
Mention of clinical conditions such as atrial fibrillation and its relationship with mitral stenosis.
